text_block_list.text:
The day of the Mile CS. A great buzz
stirred through the Kyoto Racecourse paddock.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Take that! —Aand heave-ho~!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Ahem. Amazing, right~?

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Huh? What's going on? Did something happen?

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Akebono lightly lifted a barbell
that weighed about as much as a piano...

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: For real?! Are Umamusume really that super-strong?!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
No, no, an ordinary girl wouldn't be able to
lift that up so effortlessly!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
"Just for today, you see,
I got myself totally super-buff~."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Because I knew that my rival,
Taiki-san, had gotten so, so strong.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: I just really thought to myself that I definitely don't want to lose.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to take on Taiki-san
with everything my flavor has to offer!

Silenced by Hishi Akebono's intense drive,
the buzzing stands gradually quieted down—
A massive roar erupted from the crowd!

text_block_list.name: Bono's Fan A
text_block_list.text: You can do it, Buono-chan!

text_block_list.name: Bono's Fan B
text_block_list.text: Show me a truly big race today too!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: —Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Today is an all-out showdown! I'll make it a fully satisfying race, so look forward to it~!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: ...Ghh... Nghhh!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Amazing!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I've trained myself up too!
I ran so much just to beat you!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: And so, the winner will be ME!

text_block_list.name: Taiki's Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Show them how you run!
Taiki Shuttle!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Fire up your heart
and cheer me on, please!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Ooh, sparks are totally flying between both sides!

The Mile Championship.
At last, the big showdown begins.
